text: Yellow: Plane Directors (Taxi Directors); Flight Deck Officers; Arresting Gear Officers; Catapult Officers (Shooters); Catapult spotters; Aircraft handling Officers

Green: Air Wing Maintenance personnel; Catapult and Arresting gear crews; Helicopter Landing Signal Enlisted (LSE); Cargo-handling personnel; Ground support equipment troubleshooters; Hook runners; Photographers mates
Brown: Air Wing plane captains; Air Wing line Petty Officers
Blue: Aircraft handlers (pushers, chockers, chainers, etc.); Tractor Drivers; Messengers and Phone Talkers; Elevator Operators
Purple: Fueling personnel
White: Safety personnel; Medical personnel; LSOs; Final checkers; Quality Assurance personnel; Air Transfer Officer (ATO)
Red: Ordnance crews; Crash and salvage crews; Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD)
[Figure 1-2 labels] Stern (Fantail) aft, Bow forward; Port and Starboard sides; Round Down at the aft edge of the deck.
[Figure 1-2 labels] Arresting Gear Pendants (4) Mk 7 MOD 3, marked P1-P4 across the aft landing area; Barricade marked next to the pendants.
[Figure 1-2 labels] Catapult No. 1 and No. 2 on the bow (No. 1 starboard); Catapult No. 3 and No. 4 on the angled deck / waist (No. 4 farthest to port).
[Figure 1-2 labels] No. 1, No. 2 and No. 3 Elevators on the starboard side (No. 1 and No. 2 forward of the island, No. 3 aft of it); No. 4 Elevator on the port side aft.
[Figure 1-2 labels] Island on the starboard side; Foul Lines bounding the landing area.
[Figure 1-2 labels] On the port side: LSO Platform (aft), Integrated Catapult Control Station and the Mk 6 MOD 3 Hinged Optical Landing System Platform (alongside the landing area).
[Figure 1-3 labels] Bow area spots: One Row, Two Row, Three Row, Four Row, Box and Crotch; catapults circled 1-4.
[Figure 1-3 labels] Starboard side spots from forward to aft: Point, Corral, (island), Junkyard, Patio.
[Figure 1-3 labels] Mid-deck spots alongside the landing area: SIXPAC and Street; Finger on the port side aft.
[Figure 1-4] IFLOLS configuration: vertical lens column of amber cells with two red cells at the bottom; the orange ball appears in one cell.

[Figure 1-4] Datum Lights: a horizontal row of 10 green lights on each side of the lens; Cut Lights: two green lights on each side above the datums; Waveoff Lights: vertical groups of red lights on each side of the lens.
[Figure 1-4] Photos: Mk 14 Shore-Based (trailer mounted) and Mk 13 Shipboard variants.
[Figure 1-5] The light wedge is divided into Above Optimum Glideslope (top, amber), On Optimum Glideslope (middle, green) and Below Optimum Glideslope (bottom); total wedge labelled 1.5 degrees.

[Figure 1-6] MOVLAS components: central source light column (amber upper lamps, red lower lamps); a vertical waveoff light column on each side topped by one green cut light; five green datum lights on each outer side.
[Figure 1-7] Center sector: Steady yellow 0.50 deg - On Centerline to Touchdown.
[Figure 1-7] Next sectors: Steady 0.75 deg - green on one side of centerline, red on the other.
[Figure 1-7] Next sectors: Slow Flash 4.0 deg (green / red).
[Figure 1-7] Outer sectors: Fast Flash 6.0 deg (green / red).
